settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content: Free shipping on orders over 500 EGP. Standard delivery 2–5 business days within Egypt. Returns accepted within 14 days.

settings.title: Size & Fit
settings.content: Designed with a relaxed, intentional fit. If you're between sizes, we recommend sizing up.

settings.title: Care Instructions
settings.content: Cold machine wash or hand wash. Do not tumble dry. Iron on low heat. Dry flat.
